content.text:
The member at the front of the hold queue can now check the item out, and members queued behind them no longer stop that checkout. All 62 tests pass, including the two new ones.

The bug was in `findBlockingHold` in `lib/holds/queue.js`. It treated any active hold from another member as a block, so a member queued behind the front member also blocked the front member. It now looks only at the front of `holdQueue`. It blocks when that hold belongs to someone else. It returns `null` when the queue is empty or the requester is at the front.

A member queued behind the front, or not queued at all, is still refused with `on-hold`. I didn't change `checkout.js`.

I added two tests to `test/checkout.test.js`. One checks that the front member can check out with another member queued behind. The other checks that a member behind the front is refused.
